findings.title: linux-gnu auth binaries built on Ubuntu 24.04 with no glibc floor fail to load on older Linux
findings.label: valid
findings.note: gnu legs build with plain napi build on Ubuntu 24.04 runners without the glibc 2.28 pin the FFI line uses, and no symbol-version check exists; plausible raised glibc floor.

findings.title: linux-x64-musl leg built without -crt-static: cdylib dropped, auth build fails and blocks the JS release
findings.label: match
findings.note: Flags the musl leg as built without proper linkage configuration on a glibc host and notes the preflight's musl check would not catch a mis-linked binary that fails on Alpine, recommending an Alpine load test.

findings.title: Publish path ships platform binaries without the architecture/libc/load checks the preflight performs
findings.label: match
findings.note: Identifies that a cross-built binary with wrong libc can ship because the publish-path build verifies only tarball name and .node presence, with libc checks confined to the dispatch-only preflight.
